evidence: Correctly observes ignored validation flags, but interprets Undefined variable: x as variable-banning taking effect at evaluation. This shows an unset name, not an enforced no-variable policy.
Actionable Python allowlisting, no eval, pre-parse limits, explicit errors and OWASP mappings.

Own SAFE list includes2^10, which Python parses as excluded BitXor. Validator count/depth updates are not used recursively in BinOp/Call; _check_pow inspects constants only and misses nested exponents. Thus own benign tests and declared limits fail by static inspection.
